neighbours.label: the words 'rejoice' and 'bliss'
fire: On the feast day the whole village gathered to rejoice together.
Coffee lovers, rejoice! A new café opens downtown this week.
The newlyweds spent a week of pure bliss on the island.
Let the faithful rejoice in the good news.
Their cabin by the lake was a place of quiet bliss.
Fans will rejoice when the band returns next spring.
Ignorance is bliss, as the old saying goes.
After the exams, the students felt nothing but bliss.
quiet: On the feast day the whole village gathered to celebrate together.

After the exams, the students felt nothing but relief.
